title: Durably retire proven-never-sent issued grants with whole-control-session exclusion
outcome: Complete the parent's required issued-grant retirement, safe replay and compatible-reader migration obligation.
acceptance: For an issued grant whose first Begin is proven never sent, atomically retain an exact-owner, domain-separated, full-payload retirement intent before wire transmission and promptly attempt one bounded SessionBind retirement under the existing control-call cap, with no new Evaluate, unbegun checkpoint, guessed TTL or timeout/lease inflation. A responsive authoritative-test-clock producer confirms retirement before its expiry; no universal pre-expiry guarantee is claimed during outages or delays.

Serialize all mutating calls for that exact producer control session against the unresolved retirement, including competing Begin, bind/rebind, Evaluate, boot repair and Resume/reset. Exclusion and frozen identity survive Cancel, queued-head replacement and restart. Possibly-sent or restart-ambiguous Begin keeps exact replay and is never retired on age or status-only inference; local exclusion is not represented as a producer-side CAS.

Only the matching retained retirement operation, intended control identity and internally consistent no-open-turn/no-open-grant response followed by durable local settlement report released. Failed, lost, late or stale responses preserve unresolved identity and cannot mutate a successor. Replay uses the same retirement key and payload, never the earlier pre-grant bind key.

An independently allocated compatible primary schema and transactional migration preserve existing authority and unknown Begin state. Old readers reject upgraded stores without destructive rewrite/fallback; unknown safety phases fail closed. Isolated tests cover populated migration, crash/rollback cuts, Cancel/replacement/restart survival and later-schema preservation; no live-store migration or unallocated schema number is used.

Deterministic focused controls cover healthy producer expiry, lost reply with same-key replay, restart after remote apply before local confirmation, stale owner, concurrent Begin and competing bind/Evaluate, cached original-bind-key collision, and negative no-checkpoint/no-new-Evaluate/no-successor-mutation cases. The exact frozen input passes the maintained full gate, required independent review pair and fresh independent acceptance before authorized integration.
